# `aitbc network set-sync-source`

Edit node.env and restart the blockchain node with a new sync source.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc network set-sync-source [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--url` | text | — | yes | New sync source URL (https:// or http://). |
| `--env-file` | text | `/etc/aitbc/node.env` | no | Environment file to update. |
| `--restart`, `--no-restart` | flag | `true` | no | Restart the blockchain node services after updating the env file. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc network set-sync-source --url <sync_url>
```
